scope: Original eight-rank real routing; two-H200 operation goodput calibration; modeled eight-GPU communication only

protocol.native_rt0: popularity retention disabled; balancing-required remote copies retained
protocol.native_rt2: two source-popularity retention choices per rank before balancing; shared B=8 cap
protocol.optimized: rt0 seed, reciprocal sampled residency, four global bundle-exchange rounds

model.endpoint_formula: max(max row bytes, max column bytes) / (effective one-direction GB/s * 1e6)
model.sequential_layers: sum each layer time after its own endpoint max
model.topology_assumption: one nonblocking eight-GPU NVSwitch host; no inter-node traffic
model.extra_planner_allocation: aggregate only; per-layer thresholds exclude aggregate-only charge
model.shared_endpoint_service: max endpoint(weight bytes/Bweight + forward dispatch bytes/Bdispatch), then remaining token phases and full gradient; service approximation, not rigorous physical bound
model.ideal_all_weights_hidden: optimistic bound; all baseline and candidate weights hidden equally; gradients fully counted
model.M_gt_1: analytical same-trace repetition only; fixed map, version, persistent layer replicas and gradient accumulation required; shared pool cannot provide this automatically

dispatch.interpretation: shape/direction sensitivity; not a confidence interval for eight GPUs

combine.interpretation: shape/direction sensitivity; not a confidence interval for eight GPUs

weight.interpretation: shape/direction sensitivity; not a confidence interval for eight GPUs

gradient.interpretation: shape/direction sensitivity; not a confidence interval for eight GPUs

interpretation: Positive saved_ms means faster only under the stated model.
Efficiency scenarios and two-GPU fluctuations are not confidence bounds for eight-GPU execution.
A negative planner budget means communication already loses even with zero additional planner cost.
FP32 multi-replica accumulation may reduce eight-rank gradient bandwidth beyond other traffic classes.
No production/default gate is enabled by analytical results.
